messages:
maria_support: FYI customer says their promo code is being rejected as "invalid/expired" when applying at checkout. They pasted the exact error: "Promo code SPRING25 rejected: code invalid or expired."

sam_billing: Can you drop account id + email and a screenshot? Also whether they tried via API or Console.

maria_support: Account: acct_9yXb2, user email: jon@acme-staging.com. Screenshot attached (they blurred PII). They said tried both Console and /v1/credits/redeem via curl.

jake_ops: Quick check — was SPRING25 a limited-one-time code or scoped to regions? I can look at promo service logs.

ana_engineer: @jake_ops fyi code metadata: expires_at=2025-09-01T00:00:00Z, usage_limit=1, allowed_tiers=[new_user]. Might be timezone or an existing redemption.

jake_ops: Ran a redemption lookup:
```
SELECT code, redeemed_by, redeemed_at, expires_at, usage_limit, allowed_tiers
FROM promotions
WHERE code = 'SPRING25';
```
Result: code exists, redeemed_by = 'user:acct_test_47', redeemed_at = '2025-06-12T18:03:12Z', usage_count=1.

sam_billing: That would explain invalid/expired — usage_limit reached. Could the customer be a different account but same org alias? Check for email aliases.

maria_support: Customer says they never received it and they are new. They gave alias jon+prod@acme-staging.com — similar domain. Could previous test account have used it.

ana_engineer: Two possibilities: 1) code was single-use and already consumed by internal test account, or 2) there's a bug showing usage_count=1 while usage_limit is higher. I checked logs: redemption succeeded at 2025-06-12 by acct_test_47.

jake_ops: Confirmed. Internal test harness auto-claimed some bulk codes during QA — SPRING25 was mistakenly in that pool. I can add a temporary override to allow this specific account to redeem if we want, or we can grant a manual credit.

sam_billing: For now recommend manual credit equal to the promo value so customer sees same outcome. Also start a PR to remove test accounts from production promo claim lists.

maria_support: Can we do a manual credit? Customer needs it credited today. They said it's blocking onboarding.

sam_billing: I'll issue a manual credit of $25 to acct_9yXb2 and note internal ticket. Posting transaction id when done.

promo_bot: Action taken: created credit txn txn_4c7f for acct_9yXb2 amount $25. Status: pending_review.

maria_support: Thanks! I'll message the customer and confirm. Also leaving escalation to eng for removing test accounts from promo pool — @ana_engineer can you own?

ana_engineer: Will investigate root cause and add validation to the promo ingestion script. Likely a CSV included internal test IDs. Est. fix + deploy in 48h.

jake_ops: I'll also add a small dashboard check to flag any promo with usage_count >= usage_limit and redeemed_by includes known test prefixes.

maria_support: Customer updated: saw pending credit, happy. I'll follow up once it's posted. Closing for now unless we need more info. :thumbsup:
